Privacy Policy

Last updated: August 1, 2026

1. Information We Collect

When you submit a form on our website, we collect:

  • Your name and email address
  • Your company name
  • Phone number (if provided)
  • Information about your business needs and goals

2. How We Use Your Information

We use the information you provide to:

  • Respond to your audit or consultation request
  • Send you the requested deliverables
  • Contact you about your inquiry
  • Improve our services

3. Data Storage & Sharing

Your information is stored in HubSpot CRM and Google Workspace. We do not sell your personal data to third parties. We may share data with service providers who help us operate our business (e.g., email delivery, CRM).

4. Email Communications

If you submit a form, we may send you follow-up emails related to your inquiry. You can unsubscribe from marketing emails at any time. Transactional emails (e.g., audit results) cannot be unsubscribed from.

5. Data Retention

We retain your information for as long as necessary to provide our services and comply with legal obligations. You may request deletion of your data at any time by contacting us.

6. Your Rights

You have the right to:

  • Access the personal data we hold about you
  • Request correction of inaccurate data
  • Request deletion of your data
  • Opt out of marketing communications

7. Contact

For privacy-related inquiries, contact:
